It uses fsa-square-roots-flagged-unordered-sound (order irrelevant: any subgroup point with abscissa x has ordinate +-root, grp-fl-in-group-roots), grp-fl-den-nonzero (the enforce forces d x^2 - 1 != 0), grp-fl-on-curve-iff, grp-is-in-group-gadget-sound on the square branch, and the is_zero bitness (grp-is-in-group-gadget-out-bit) on the non-square branch. R1CS-COMPLETE not proved: on a non-square it needs is_in_group completeness on the off-curve (x, 0) with the raw add/double formulas (curve-raw-is-in-group), which no proved gadget lemma covers yet. R1CS-SOUND kept 0: grp-from-x-flagged-gadget-sound assumes the funspec does not halt on x, which is not a prior circuit.
